findings.F1: The test's result is on the side the idea predicts but short of the bar. The main measure was +0.0080 with a day-clustered t of 1.59 over 930 cases on 340 distinct days. Its size was an unusual move of +0.33 % per case (t 0.90), which is 0.035 of a usual 5-day move of 10.60 %. That is the right sign and too small for six coins to show clearly.

findings.F4: The idea's side does carry something once each window's drift is removed. Against their own coin-window's mean 5-day return, calm down days were followed by a further fall of +1.28 % in the short direction (t 3.04, 408 cases). The calm up and flat days of the same trends were not: choppy -1.0 % (t -1.4), falling -0.5 % (t -0.5), rising -4.3 % (t -3.1).
findings.F5: The continuation is broad across coins but weak in each one, so more coins add evidence. All six coins are positive at 5 days in calm down cases, from +0.7 % (ETH, t 0.57) to +2.6 % (XMR, t 2.54). It is strongest in a falling trend (+3.0 %, t 3.1, n 116) and absent in a rising one (+0.2 %, t 0.25, n 85).

ideas.name: calm big fall, more coins
ideas.idea: In a calm market, the larger a coin's one-day fall against the standard deviation of its daily returns over the past 30 days, the larger its fall over the next 5 days.
ideas.consequence: In calm markets, a day large against the coin's usual swing starts a move that continues in its own direction, downward after a down day, and more so the larger the day.
